rationale: Both are short and correct, with the same recite loop. A tries to remove more duplication with capitalize() and an inline 'it'/'one' conditional, but it still special-cases n == 0. Inside that branch it hard-codes 'no more bottles of beer' rather than calling _bottles(n), so the abstraction is applied inconsistently. The general-case f-string with the embedded conditional is also a bit dense. B states the two irregular verses explicitly and keeps the regular verse as one plain template, so a reader can see exactly what each verse produces. Its _bottles helper has a zero case that is never reached, which is a trivial wart. Overall B is the more readable of the two.
